statement: Dino 8 must keep pan, zoom and orbit fast on large 3D models in wireframe, realistic and shaded visual styles, and custom styles using matching settings must achieve the same speed.

source.ref: How can I get the fastest 3D display performance?

acceptance.sketch: Orbit a large model in the Shaded style and assert frame rate stays above a threshold that is higher than with a heavy custom style.

notes: Added from help page "How can I get the fastest 3D display performance?"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.
